explicit_source_findings: Scripts are pre-written magical overlays that alter one spell, including damage type, delayed activation, secondary effects, and shape/radius.
Macros are sigil/glyph-based magical constructs that chain spells, encode triggers/conditions/timing, synchronize casters, and carry resonance risk.
Sigilcrafting explicitly embeds symbols, glyphs, and logic structures into magical casting.
The crafting source explicitly says an enchanter binds runes and manages charge capacity.
Rune Carving Basics grants +2 to Arcana checks when engraving runes and reduces the DC for basic rune engraving by 2.
Perfect Rune Placement grants +1 to rune-carving rolls and rewards exceeding a crafting DC by 5+ with a minor item bonus.
Magic rings may be fitted with gemstones, symbols, or runes representing origin or school of magic for identification/lore.
The retained sources do not publish a canonical basic-rune vocabulary, connection-type grammar, shaping grammar, or deterministic rune-composition algorithm.

source_conflicts_and_gaps.rule: Preserve the published conflict between detailed-tree values and Appendix D; do not silently reconcile.
Owner design intent calls for basic reusable runes, but retained sources do not enumerate them.
Owner design intent calls for connection types, but retained sources do not define a rune topology grammar.
Scripts can alter spell shape/radius, but a rune-specific shaping syntax is not published.

visual_review.method: rendered all nine retained PDFs to page images and visually reviewed contact sheets; text extraction used only as a search aid
